## source_to_kb

### Variant parameters and base policies
These are the same full-domain checks recorded in task 0's file, repeated for this task: all 48 parameters x 6 order types match the schedule documents, and the base atoms and the retired surface are correct. Relevant here: `quote_pricing_rules` 2.1/3.1 retire the unit-price and quote-total clauses for "a re-issue of a lapsed infrastructure quote"; `quote_approval_and_purchase_order_terms` 3.1 retires the deposit clause for Network/Server orders within the credit limit; `order_cancellation_rules` retires the fee clause, including its deposit-application half, for Network/Server orders ("settled under the infrastructure cancellation and deposit-credit schedules"). The two overwrites declared on `hardware_cancellation` (by the fee policy and by the deposit-credit policy) are both reflected, and the clause stays in force for Accessory, Staged and Special-Order types.

### hardware_ext_infrastructure_cancellation_fee (target sign_infrastructure_cancellation_1779b7d3)
- Hub `network_and_server_order_signed_cancellation`: subject, scope/replaced_by, after-signature effects, tool contract. These match task_tools.py (status cancelled, after_po, cancelled and closed today, fee invoice). Equivalent.
- Baseline `infrastructure_order_cancellation_fee`: 15 / 25 percent of quote total (figures named from the cancellation terms), cap at deposit paid ("the sum of the payments on its ledger counted up to the deposit invoiced"), rounded once. The cap is an assembly step of the source's fixed order and sits in the computation doc, as required. Complete.
- Factors, each with its own doc and full ladder: bench_stage_build 40.00/unit at most 1 day, percentage + 20.00/unit at least 7 days, percentage alone otherwise (`bench_staging_stage_on_infrastructure_cancellations`); infra_tier_rate 9.0 / 12.0 / 15|25 (`clearpath_tier_rates_for_infrastructure_cancellations`); project_scope_points 2.0 / 1.0 / none, largest class decides, in-progress only (`project_engagement_points_on_infrastructure_cancellations`); arrears_fee_points 3.0 / 1.0 / none (`late_payment_points_on_infrastructure_cancellations`); covered_seat_points 1.5 at 25+, 0.5 at 10-24, none (`covered_seat_points_on_infrastructure_cancellations`); tenure_loyalty_points 1.5 at 48+, 0.5 at 24-47, none, counted from go-live (`clearpath_loyalty_points_on_infrastructure_cancellations`).
- Assembly ("percentage first; fee built; built fee capped"): the percentage docs all act on "the infrastructure fee percentage"; the build doc uses "the fee percentage"; the cap is in the computation doc. Equivalent.

### hardware_ext_cancelled_deposit_credit (target post_deposit_credit_9245a342, trigger state_due)
- Hub `deposit_return_on_cancelled_network_and_server_orders`: rule (credit booked against the deposit invoice; fee stands against the credit balance; remainder refunded or carried), scope/replaced_by, tool contract (agent-owned; credit entry dated today against the deposit invoice; balance reduced; negative balance refunded or carried). Matches task_tools.py.
- **Prerequisite (state form)**: "The deposit credit of a cancelled infrastructure order is fixed only after the order shows status cancelled and its ledger carries the cancellation fee charged on it." It is verbatim in the hub's **Waiting state**, with a same-form restatement, and in no other document. Resolution basis: the depended-on hub `network_and_server_order_signed_cancellation` states the write "moves the order to cancelled ... and books the cancellation fee on the order's billing ledger as a new invoice". Records: 759febca `status 'ordered'`, ledger without a fee. Hard gate; strength matches.
- Baseline `infrastructure_deposit_credit_amount`: deposit paid (payments counted up to the deposit invoiced) less 145.00 / 395.00 per unit, floor zero, rounded once. Complete. The floor belongs to the source's assembly order and sits in the computation doc.
- Factors, each full: bench_retention_basis nothing at 0-2 days, pro rata x days/14 at 3-13, whole at 14+, none when not cancelled (`bench_slot_retention_on_cancelled_infrastructure_orders`); tenure_handling_retention full / half / nothing at 24/48 months (35.00 / 17.50 / 0; 75.00 / 37.50 / 0) (`clearpath_tenure_handling_retention_on_deposit_credits`); expedite_retention rush fee / half / nothing (`rush_retention_on_cancelled_infrastructure_orders`); project_coordination_retention 60.00 / 30.00 / nothing (`project_coordination_retention_on_deposit_credits`); managed_goodwill_credit 100.00 / 50.00 / nothing (`clearpath_goodwill_on_deposit_credits`).

- Hub `reissue_of_lapsed_network_and_server_quotes`: subject (keeps number, part, quantity, distributor cost; re-prices; re-dates; replaces unit price and total), both overwrites with base clauses kept for other quotes, tool contract. Matches.
- Baseline `lapsed_infrastructure_quote_reissue_total`: unit = cost x (1 + 18 / 12 percent), rounded; total = units + 145.00 / 395.00 per unit + 35.00 / 75.00 + 150.00 / 350.00 with rush, no re-issue charge, rounded once; the order of assembly is stated. Complete.
- Factors, each full: reissue_markup_reduction 5.0 / the order type's 3|2 / none, with the re-pricing rounding (`clearpath_markup_reduction_on_reissued_quotes`); managed_bench_staging_rate 95.00 (coverage + in-progress project) / 120.00 (coverage, no project) / 145|395 (`network_device_coverage_bench_staging_rates`); reissue_tenure_handling nothing / 20.00 / 35|75 at 48/24 months (`clearpath_tenure_handling_on_reissued_quotes`); reissue_account_rush nothing (named TAM) / 75.00 (named CSM, no TAM) / 150|350 (`account_manager_rush_charge_on_reissued_quotes`); lapse_charge_basis 60.00/unit beyond 30 days, 1.5 percent of units x cost at 8-30 days, nothing at 0-7 days after "the quote date plus the order type's quote validity days" (`lapse_period_reissue_charges`).
- Findability of the two coverage-based factors: both documents name the product ("ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement") and the attribute read ("read from the coverage of the client's ClearPath agreement whose status is active"), using the managed charter's own wording ("named client success manager", "named technical account manager", "firewall, switch and wireless configuration changes"). The coverage values themselves are ClearPath charter parameters (`dedicated_account_manager`, `technical_account_manager`, `network_device_management_included`), not hardware atoms. See XP-1 in the runtime file: they will be visible only once a ClearPath corpus is published. This is not a hardware bijection defect.

## dependency_form

- The three prerequisite sentences stand verbatim, in state form, only in their blocked hubs. Their restatements stay in the same form and name no action, performer or tool.
- The re-issue edge and the deposit-credit edge are stated as two separate sentences in the approval hub, as the source states them. Nothing aggregates them with the cancellation hop, and no list orders the four problems.
- `network_and_server_order_signed_cancellation` says its "paid deposit is returned under the infrastructure deposit-credit schedule". This is the source's own replaced_by sentence for the fee policy (a scope statement). It does not tell the reader that the credit waits on the cancellation or that the approval waits on the credit, so it is not RED.
- Titles are general ("Network Equipment and Server & Storage Build Quote Approval with Deposit", "Re-Issue of Lapsed Network Equipment and Server & Storage Build Quotes", "Returning the Paid Deposit of a Cancelled Network or Server Order"). None mirrors task 1's 24-to-48-port switch situation.
- Computation docs carry no variation hints. Factor docs carry no pointers, no "most customers" statements and no task evidence rows.

**KB-EXPLICIT PASS.**
